author: awesome_apricot
body:
This map has been hanging around on multiworld on my server for sometime now, so I thought now would be a good time to release it :D

Its GM is OITC, or could even be converted t Nexus, but that would mean a few adjustments. 

Its concept was thought up Shiro who imagined a huge door for a start... That doors was remade maybe 2-3 times just to make it look good by Shiro, Tel, Hughsie and I. When I shortly came back after doing something I saw that the brickwork for the walls had been done...

Then it was up to me and Shiro to finish off. We added all of the stuff you can see inside the room... I won't take credit for the Funky statue, that  was Shiro, I just helped a little with the shape, but most of the other stuff is made y us two equally. 

Oh, yeah, and that flipping Avicus logo took me well over 2 1/2 hours to get right, so appreciate that too ^_^

name: Rats
YML: http://pastie.org/private/yfm4tnngqwxf30qb99kcyq
download: https://www.dropbox.com/s/8mbj825heke40pj/Rats.rar
Pictures: I have a video... It's poorly edited, but hey, that's what you get when you're bored of revising and decide to do a quick map release... https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pXrxAsUlFnM&feature=youtu.be
creators: Shirokamii & awesome_apricot with help from Tel6331 and Hughsie 1

We hope y'all like.
